identity.title: Uncover All the Mysteries! The Pocket Monsters XY&Z Complete Overview Special!

leadText:
(Japanese: すべてのナゾを解き明かせ！ポケットモンスターXY&Z完全マスタースペシャル！！ Uncover All the Mysteries! The XY&Z Complete Overview Special!!) is a two-hour animated series special that aired in Japan on December 31, 2015.

The first one-hour part consisted of Pokémon: Mega Evolution Special IV and From A to Z!. The second one-hour part consist of looking back at past adventures, attempting to understand the mysteries. It also looks at upcoming developments.

 

 
 

zh:解开全部的谜团！宝可梦 XY&Z 掌握一切的特别篇!!
